title: Beyond the Black Box: Interpretability of LLMs in Finance

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) feature activations in response to hypothetical loan applications containing gender-specific terms (e.g., 'female entrepreneurs', 'Male applicants'). The paper calculates a 'bias ratio' based on the percentage of bias-related features activated to flag potentially discriminatory language.
Evaluating SAE feature activation levels and calculating bias ratios for loan application prompts that include marital status identifiers (e.g., 'single mother') to detect bias representations.

Using hypothetical loan application statements containing ethnicity identifiers to simulate realistic biases, and monitoring the activation magnitudes of specific SAE features to pinpoint discriminatory outcomes.
